title: Extract Java Class with Guice Field Injection

source.description: Absolute path to the source .java file to extract from (operates on its first top-level class).

target.description: Absolute path to the new target .java file to create.

module_name.description: Simple name of the extracted target class.

delegate_field.description: Name of the delegate field the source will hold to the new class. Emitted as `@Inject private <module_name> <delegate_field>;` (no constructor wiring).

item_names.description: Method names to move into the target class.

move_fields.description: Field names to move into the target class.

operations.label: guice_wiring_applied
operations.body: Extracted '${inputs.module_name}' with Guice field-injection wiring: the source delegate field '${inputs.delegate_field}' is annotated @Inject (no constructor wiring) and the generated target constructor is annotated @Inject. The DI container populates the delegate after construction. Verify the module bindings make '${inputs.module_name}' injectable.
